name: C3k2

whatIsIt.eli5: YOLO11's main helper team. It works like YOLOv8's C2f, but the helpers inside can be small teams of their own.
whatIsIt.simple: YOLO11's main feature block. It has the same shape as C2f (split, a chain of small blocks, join everything), but each small block is either a plain Bottleneck or a C3k (a mini CSP block). Newer versions can also put an attention step inside.
whatIsIt.engineer: C2f subclass whose inner ModuleList holds Bottleneck (c3k=False) or C3k(c, c, n=2) (c3k=True) units; optional attn=True variant uses Bottleneck + PSABlock. Hidden width c = int(c2·e).

whyExists.eli5: Small teams inside the team can look further around each spot, and the model can choose cheap or strong helpers per size.
whyExists.simple: C3k units stack two bottlenecks each, so they see a wider area. Smaller YOLO11 models use plain Bottlenecks and a narrower hidden width (e = 0.25 in early layers) to stay light; bigger models switch to C3k.
whyExists.engineer: Configurable depth per unit (c3k), plus width ratio e, trades receptive field and capacity against cost; parse_model forces c3k=True for m/l/x scales.

eli5: A first helper rewrites the notes.
The notes are cut into two piles.
One pile goes through a line of helpers (or small teams); each result is kept.
simple: cv1 (1×1 Conv) makes 2c channels; c = output width × e.
Split into two halves of c channels.
Each inner unit (Bottleneck or C3k) works on the latest half; every result is kept.
Join 2 + n pieces and mix them with cv2 (1×1 Conv).
engineer: c3k flag comes from the YAML (args[1]) but parse_model sets it True for scales m, l, x.
C3k(c, c, 2, shortcut, g): C3 with two k×k bottlenecks.
attn=True (used by the last neck block in yolo26.yaml: args [1024, True, 0.5, True]): Sequential(Bottleneck, PSABlock(c, 0.5, max(c//64, 1))).

example.eli5: In YOLO11n layer 6, 128 layers of notes go in and out, and the inside helpers are small teams.
example.simple: YOLO11n layer 6: C3k2 with c3k=True, 128 → 128 channels at 40×40, n = 1 (2 × depth 0.5), 87,040 parameters. Layer 2 uses c3k=False and e = 0.25: only 6,640 parameters.

typicalPositions.eli5: After each shrinking step and in the mixing part.
typicalPositions.simple: Same places as C2f in YOLOv8: after every stride-2 Conv in the backbone and after every Concat in the neck (YOLO11, YOLO12 neck, YOLO26).
typicalPositions.engineer: Backbone stages and PAN-FPN fusion nodes of YOLO11/26.

tradeoffs.eli5: Small teams see more but cost more.
tradeoffs.simple: c3k=True roughly doubles the work per unit. A smaller e makes the block much cheaper but narrower.
tradeoffs.engineer: Cost ∝ n·(bottlenecks per unit); e scales hidden width quadratically in MACs.
